description: Plan: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-sc8.57.html (revision 2), ticket 2. Silent wrong answer at d0c490721: '@spec f(integer) :: integer; @spec f(float) :: integer; def f(x :: integer), do: x + 1; def f(x :: float), do: 0' called as f(JSON.decode!("\"s\"")) prints 0 on interp, run and build; Elixir's equivalent raises FunctionClauseError. Cause: the any argument is narrowed to the spec domain (narrow_any_witnesses), and refine_contract_inputs (jobs/semantic.rs ~2182) writes that into the callee activation key, so fz-sc8.44's trim removes the callee's arm of last resort. Fix: the contract answers the return from the part that can return; the callee is keyed on the observed argument. Kernel arithmetic gains default clauses (def _ + _, do: arithmetic_error(), and so on) routing to ArithmeticError through the named panic route. Pins may rise where tests were wrongly removed; each rise is measured, explained and brought to the user.
title: A spec never narrows its callee's input
